turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi! How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, my name's Crystal Minh, silver member

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I bought this MK shirt from you, but I'm afraid it came in the wrong color, so I need to return it

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Ah!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I apologize.

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Crystal Minh.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Can I please have your username, email address, and order ID?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: cm803069@email.com

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Purchase validation in progress ...

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What is the purchase date?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It was November 30th

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: So that was less than 6 months ago.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm afraid I hadn't even opened the box until now, but aside from the packing tape, everything is still in its original packaging

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No worries, your still in the return frame.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: ah, good

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What is your address so that you can print out the shipping label?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: 5953 Woodshore St  Raleigh, WA 74646

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Details of 5953 Woodshore St Raleigh, WA 74646 have been entered.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you want to process the return?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I could probably just mail it back

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Valid options are by mail, in store, or at a drop off center.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Order has been updated with by mail.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You are all set!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there anything else I can do for you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that's perfect.  Thanks for all your help

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great. You have a good day!
